<thought>Analyzing the spectrum shows a monoisotopic peak at 134.11 Da with successive +1 Da peaks decreasing in intensity exactly as expected for the natural 13C isotopic distribution (≈1 % per carbon). This pattern uniquely identifies carbon in the sample. No other element exhibits a +1 Da isotopic series with this characteristic intensity drop, so carbon is the only element we can definitively confirm.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
